import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0224 (a b : List Nat) : a ++ (b.reverse) = (a.reverse ++ b).reverse := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0224 (a b : List Nat) : a ++ (b.reverse) = (a.reverse ++ b).reverse := by
  induction a with
  | nil => simp [List.reverse]
  | cons a head a tail ih => simp [List.reverse, List.append, List.reverse, List.append]
  exact (a.reverse ++ (b.reverse.reverse))
END BY

END BY.
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0224 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0224 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0224

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0224
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0224
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
